It’s that time of year again! Let’s have a look at the deals we, and our much loved community are offering this year. It’s the most important time of year for independents, so let’s give them our support 💛

Josh Comeau is here producing the goods, yet again. The CRT effect he’s achieved is delightful too.

Pavel here with plenty of sage advice on how to navigate an industry in flux.

Aside from $ variables I think mixins are the main thing I miss from Sass. This is going to be a very useful addition to CSS!

Kilian is one of the best in the biz at explaining APIs and this API really does reduce the need for third party dependencies.

Things are not going well for the AI industry! I think it’s time to reverse the mandates now, rather than waiting for the inevitable burst.

Thanks so much for reading this issue of The Index and lending us your time.

The best way for people to discover this newsletter is if you share it with your friends, so I'd really appreciate it if you did that.

Until the next issue, take it easy 👋 Andy
